title: Best Imac (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Picks were made by analyzing reviews from PCMag, CNET, Tom's Guide, and Consumer Reports, prioritizing products recommended by multiple sources.

verdict.line: It suits most buyers because it offers a powerful M4 processor and a 16GB RAM minimum without a price increase over the previous generation. The main catch is that the standard 256GB SSD is insufficient for many users and upgrades are pricey.
